title: Data Security in the AI Era, Don't Let AI Ruin your Presentation, and the Weekly News - ESW #480
description:
Interview with Hadar Krasner, Co-Founder and CPO of Bold Security

This week's interview with Hadar is a fascinating dive into the history of data security and why they chose to tackle endpoint-focused data security. We discuss why securing data is traditionally such a challenging task, making it clear why Bold is such a fitting name for the company. After 30 minutes, we barely scratched the surface and are hoping we can have them back soon for another interview!

Segment Resources:

- https://www.bold.security/blog/endpoint-data-ai-human-risk-convergence
- https://www.bold.security/blog/what-is-real-time-endpoint-data-protection-bold-makes-it-a-reality

This segment is sponsored by Bold Security. Visit https://securityweekly.com/bold-security to learn more about them!

Topic - Don't Let AI Ruin Your Talk

In this week's topic segment, we discuss the emerging epidemic of low-effort AI-generated slides. AI can definitely make slide creation less painful, but you still need to put some effort in to make a good looking deck that makes sense. If you don't, your audience WILL notice.

Enterprise Security News

Finally, in the enterprise security news, 

1. we discuss the Sawtooth problem
2. cybersecurity is center stage in AI
3. not everyone is a big fan of passkeys
4. Ross Haleliuk is back with some interesting essays
5. insider threats: sometimes the cybercriminal was inside your organization all along
6. AI can now read your mind
7. and as always, we’ll kick off with the vibes

All that and more, on this episode of Enterprise Security Weekly.

Visit https://www.securityweekly.com/esw for all the latest episodes!
